style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Repin and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges away from the faces, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; a single warm lamp as the only light, two-thirds of the picture in deep brown-black shadow; ordinary, unidealised faces, not glamorous, painted in a few planes; a candid, unposed moment, figures off-centre. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: close. Close: the young woman lays her hand on the doctor's hand on the table and speaks gravely; warm lamplight on the two hands and her face.
Shot: medium. The young woman lies back in her chair, pale and spent, the phonograph earpieces in her lap; the doctor has jumped up with a horrified face and pours brandy from a decanter.
